notes.title: The follow-up to , , now has an Steam page!
notes.notes:
The Steam store page for the next project by the creators of <Hotel Sowls>, titled [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2887690/Cheese_Moon/?beta=0]<Cheese Moon>, now has an Steam store page[/url]! If you add it to your wishlist, you'll be able to receive updates about <Cheese Moon> promptly!

Also, the [url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/view/738995?utm_campaign=cp_po_share_c_msg_mypage_projects_show]crowdfunding campaign for <Cheese Moon>[/url] is currently being enthusiastically conducted on the Japanese crowdfunding site Campfire until April 21st.

Dive into the adventure with charming rabbits and the dark plots hidden behind the cheese moon... Your support is essential for bringing <Cheese Moon> into existence.

We are always grateful for the interest and support you have provided us, and we kindly ask for your continued attention and for sharing our project.

Thank you!

notes.title: We're working on our new game, !
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We've got some exciting news to share today! We're currently in the process of working on a new game called <Cheese Moon>, and we're crowdfunding it through Tumblbug, a Korean crowdfunding platform similar to Kickstarter.

Since Tumblbug is based in Korea, it could be a bit tricky for those who don't reside in Korea to take part in the funding. Nevertheless, we wanted to let you know that we're hard at work on our new game.

[url=https://tumblbug.com/cheesemoon][img]https://tumblbug-psi.imgix.net/da55d49c72146cd5042c3c71153d4c0712ef9277/4230dd0364f0d1405b8c4f3b56abe2e1a8275c48/dec43eaa7f7f44d7a6dd6afee919b08321b45d1d/11d93d86-0a61-4dbb-9e9d-d66b7c82321d.png?ixlib=rb-1.1.0&w=1240&auto=format%2C%20compress&lossless=true&ch=save-data&s=8050b53ec2baac0bc805c399d56e8949[/img][/url]

<Cheese Moon> is a stage adventure game set on the moon and in space. It follows the story of moon-dwelling rabbits who embark on a journey of uncovering a massive conspiracy related to the moon and cheese, all while riding in a flying saucer.


We'll be sure to update you again once the game is fully developed!
Have a good day.

notes.title: has been fully translated into Japanese!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932415/c55cc0821197f0ae46a857402641df5b20f443af.gif[/img]

<Hotel Sowls> has been fully translated into Japanese!
Until now, <Hotel Sowls>’s Japanese translation had been providing incomplete translations based on machine translation, but thanks to the help of many people, it has become a better Japanese translation. If you find it more comfortable playing <Hotel Sowls> in Japanese, please check it out.
Thank you so much for helping us translate.

Also, many minor bug patches have been updated.

As always, thank you for playing <Hotel Sowls>!

notes.title: FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932415/c55cc0821197f0ae46a857402641df5b20f443af.gif[/img]

Hello everyone! <Hotel Sowls> is now fully released on STEAM! :D

We added a new ending, more achievements, some trivial easter eggs and details.
Also now we support Japanese language. Check it if you feel more comfortable when using Japanese.

Recommendations to your friends will be much appreciated XD

[list]
[*] New maps and quests.
[*] Some hotel services are now available.
[*] Some achievements are now much easier to achieve.
[*] Added new 11 achievements.
[*] You can change journal's category with w, s key, and can change journal's contents with a,d key.
[*] You can skip conversation with space key.
[*] Added trivial easter eggs and details.
[*] Added dancing tomato.
[/list]


…And as always, thanks for playing Hotel Sowls!

notes.title: Patch Note #4 :: Fullscreen mode available
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I've just released a new patch.
We added full screen mode and some options in this update!

[h1]
Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Videos now play correctly in Windows 7.
[*] No more jittering when player hits the walls or objects.
[*] The achievement ’Prank call’ can now be achieved when played online if you have achieved it in offline mode.
[*] Players will no longer get stuck in certain areas.
[*] Corrected the price of eggs.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Settings section added. Now you can set the keymapping, turn the autosave off, mute the background music, and play in a fullscreen mode.
[*] Player character will now let you know if you use wrong items on them.
[*] Wider clickable area of some notes.
[*] The price of eggs increased.
[/list]


...and minor bug fixes.



Thanks for playing Hotel Sowls!

notes.title: 패치노트 #1 :: 호텔 소울즈 출시!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33932415/c55cc0821197f0ae46a857402641df5b20f443af.gif[/img]


[h1]안녕하세요! 호텔 소울즈가 드디어 얼리 억세스로 출시되었습니다![/h1]


늘 사이트에 개발노트를 쓰다가 무려 패치노트를 쓰게 되니 감개무량하네요.

출시를 하고 나니 감사하게도 많은 분들이 플레이 해 주시고 반응이나 의견을 주셨어요. 그 중에서 특히 많이 얘기가 나왔던 부분 위주로 업데이트를 진행했습니다.


[list]
[*]아직 추가되지 않은 2회차 전용 엔딩이 엔딩 리스트에서 '업데이트 예정'으로 표시됩니다.

[*]정원의 풀들 사이에 캐릭터가 끼이는 문제를 해결하였습니다.

[*][b]낮, 밤이 바뀔 때 자동으로 저장되도록 하였습니다.[/b]

[*]스토리에 필수적인 아이템에 대한 힌트 등이 추가되었습니다.

[*]특정 아이템을 사용할 경우, 선택지에서 취소를 눌러도 아이템이 사라지는 버그를 수정하였습니다.

[*]특정 이벤트 중간에 쪽지를 주우면 게임이 굳는 버그를 수정하였습니다.

[*]엘리베이터 사용에 관한 힌트를 추가하였습니다.
[/list]


앞으로도 더 편하고 즐거운 플레이를 위해 노력하겠습니다. 

의견이 있으시면 스튜디오 소트 공식 메일(studio.sott@gmail.com) , 트위터(@Studio_SOTT), 스팀 토론 페이지 등에 올려주세요. 

감사합니다!
